| Baseline annual MACE rate | 5 | 5 |
| Relative risk reduction in MACE | 0.30 | 0.35 |

   - Incorporate manufacturer PAPs into the coverage model to offset out‑of‑pocket costs, potentially reducing overall plan spend by encouraging higher adherence.

### 5. Conclusion

Covering semaglutide and tirzepatide in a self‑insured plan presents a classic high‑cost, high‑benefit scenario. The direct drug spend far exceeds the projected annual savings from reduced comorbidities when considering only medical claims; however, indirect benefits—productivity gains, lower disability claims, and improved quality of life—could shift the balance over time.
